Board meeting notes - CFO financial update (raw notes, V. Wang presenting; notes taken live, figures preliminary and not yet reconciled with the final close)

- Q3 net loss approx. $6.8M vs. $1.9M plan (CFO said final number may move slightly after close). Occupancy down to roughly 71%, churn in Westbrook and Dunmore locations.
- Leverage covenant (Senior Facility s.7.2): about 3.1x vs. 2.75x max per CFO's draft calc; appears to exceed the limit as of 9/30 test date, pending counsel's reading of the definition of Consolidated EBITDA (add-backs may change the result).
- Interest coverage possibly below minimum (~1.6x vs 2.0x), same caveat on definitions.
- Cross-default provision in Meridian mezzanine agreement may be triggered if senior breach is confirmed and no waiver is obtained; counsel to confirm.
- Waiver request to senior lenders targeted for early Dec (Dec 1 mentioned). If denied, acceleration could be possible in Q1 2027; CFO's downside case reportedly puts default likelihood at something like 60%, though base case assumptions were not discussed in detail.
- Liquidity runway roughly 5 months at current burn, depending on timing of lease renewals and collections.

Action: Board requested counsel review of default remedies. Restructuring options to be presented at next meeting.
